what_was_done: Extended marker-driven-routing reconciler rule (xfc) with hybrid event-first / filesystem-walk-fallback discovery (beads_web-hs5). Modified src/lib/reconciler-rules/marker-driven-routing.ts to add filesystem-walk fallback in matches() when event-based discovery returns zero matches. Added listRegisteredRepos, listMarkerFiles, readBeadStatus callbacks to MarkerDrivenRoutingRuleOptions. Updated reconciler-bootstrap.ts throttle from 60_000 to 300_000 ms (5 min per ADR-hs5 Q3) and wired filesystem-walk callbacks. Created orphan-recovery test suite with 6 unit tests + 1 integration test.
what_was_tested: 13 marker-driven-routing tests pass (6 original xfc + 7 new hs5). Full suite: 1927 passed, 11 failed (all pre-existing failures in fleet-config.auto-chain, pipeline-routes, agent-launcher.atomic-state — unrelated to hs5, confirmed by reproducing failures on clean main). Test command: npx jest --testPathPattern=marker-driven-routing — 13 passed, 0 failed.
deviations_from_ac: None. All 8 ACs satisfied. readBeadStatus implemented via bd show --json (clean API available, no STOP needed per risk flag). Cross-repo bd-query convention works cleanly.
recommendation_for_next: Ship to prod, monitor lmxb auto-route on first reconciler tick after deploy. The filesystem-walk fallback will discover factory-core-lmxb-planner.json within 5 min of the reconciler starting with this code.

surprises_or_findings.detail: bd show --json cleanly returns status field ('open'/'closed') — build plan risk flag for CROSS-REPO-QUERY-GAP did not materialize. readBeadStatus implemented as bd show <id> --json parse.

11 pre-existing test failures in 3 suites (fleet-config.auto-chain.test.ts x2, pipeline-routes.test.ts x1, agent-launcher.atomic-state.test.ts x8). All reference old fleet-core path or have drifted pipeline label assertions. Confirmed pre-existing by reproducing on clean main (git stash + run). Not caused by hs5.
